mapper.select: SELECT cache_key, feature, prompt_version, result_json, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, hit_count, created_at FROM ai_result_cache WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_result_cache (cache_key, feature, prompt_version, result_json, model, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{feature}, #{promptVersion}, #{resultJson}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens})
